title: Qatar, Bessent Signal Iran Deal Could Be Coming
title_cn: 卡塔尔，贝森特暗示伊朗协议可能即将到来
summary: Hopes of a new deal between Iran and the US are rising. Qatar says a proposal has been drafted. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says there could a deal Tuesday or Wednesday to open the Strait of Hormuz. Bloomberg's Jeff Mason has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Mamdani Dismisses Business Leaders Advising NYC Mayor’s Fund
title_cn: 马姆达尼解雇了为纽约市市长基金提供建议的商界领袖
summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani dismissed the business and civic leaders who advised a multimillion-dollar fund that channels private donations into public programs, removing a longstanding group of corporate advisers from City Hall’s philanthropic arm.

title: US Sends Election Monitors to Four Michigan Cities for Primary
title_cn: 美国向密歇根州四个城市派遣选举监测员进行初选
summary: The US Justice Department sent election monitors to four Michigan cities on Tuesday as the state holds a closely watched primary that will set the November lineup for an open US Senate seat — one of the most competitive contests of the 2026 midterms.
